conventions: tree with m interaction vertices 1..m (depth-first), A = m+1, B = m+2; variables x_0 .. x_{2m-2}: x_s on [0,1] (the series parameter of the root), the other variables on a product of standard simplices (each entry of "simplices" lists the variables of one simplex {x_i >= 0, sum x_i <= 1}, Lebesgue measure); polynomials as [[exponents], "p/q"]; current on the external edge e: y_e = a_e lambda + q beta_e T; density = iota
